target: future valid Up midpoint minus current decision midpoint in probability points, frozen 15-second horizon
primary_metric: equal-market mean squared error in probability points squared, lower is better
primary_contrast: B3 three-seed prediction mean minus B2 same-history XGBoost paired market MSE
practical_effect_rule: Before final reveal, B3 is preferred only if April-style chronological dev market MSE is at least 1% lower than B2; report every arm on final regardless of selection. A positive final claim also requires paired market CI upper bound below zero and remains within-date only.
uncertainty: 5000 paired market bootstrap draws with fixed seed; markets are the resampling units, conditional on only four captured UTC dates. Also report per-date and contract-length descriptive counts/metrics without tuning.
training_weights: Each train market has equal total weight; no final market or label enters normalization, fit, checkpointing or selection.

B1.features: ten current-state PM1A features from the last captured book

B2.features: identical eight-by-eleven causal PM1A history tensor as B3, flattened

B3.features: identical eight-by-eleven causal PM1A history tensor as B2
B3.early_stopping: minimum dev equal-market MSE after train-only feature and target standardization

configuration_search: one fixed XGB/GRU configuration, no final-data tuning and no Transformer
final_rule: Push exact code/config, dev results and fitted model hashes before building or scoring the final repricing target. Open final once, score all B0-B3 and all seeds, preserve null/negative results; no refit, threshold change or re-sealing.
limits: Collector snapshot time, sparse changed-book rows, four sampled UTC dates and partial final date. Not terminal information, exact exchange return, fills, PnL or WSE independent confirmation.
